result.card: This PR removes legacy reverse-precedence resolution code in the settings manager, making later settings consistently take precedence over earlier settings. It relies on base PR #17493 disallowing ambiguous multiple assignments to single-value settings in configuration files. As an internal cleanup, it has no direct user-facing impact or behavioral change. Reviewers should focus on base PR #17493 before reviewing this PR.
